content.title: Synchronization for Modern Web Apps
content.explanation:
**Advanced Web Waiting Strategies:**

**1. Page Load Synchronization**

```vbscript
' Basic page sync
Browser("App").Page("Home").Sync

' Sync with timeout
If Browser("App").Page("Home").Sync(15) Then
    ' Page loaded within 15 seconds
Else
    ' Timeout - handle error
End If

' Wait for specific URL
Function WaitForUrl(expectedUrl, timeout)
    Dim startTime
    startTime = Timer
    
    Do While Timer < startTime + timeout
        currentUrl = Browser("App").GetROProperty("url")
        If InStr(currentUrl, expectedUrl) > 0 Then
            WaitForUrl = True
            Exit Function
        End If
        Wait 1
    Loop
    
    WaitForUrl = False
End Function

' Wait for document ready state
Function WaitForDocumentReady(timeout)
    Dim startTime
    startTime = Timer
    
    Do While Timer < startTime + timeout
        readyState = Browser("App").Page("Page").RunScript("return document.readyState")
        If readyState = "complete" Then
            WaitForDocumentReady = True
            Exit Function
        End If
        Wait 1
    Loop
    
    WaitForDocumentReady = False
End Function
```

**2. AJAX and Dynamic Content**

```vbscript
' Wait for AJAX to complete
Function WaitForAjax(timeout)
    Dim startTime
    startTime = Timer
    
    Do While Timer < startTime + timeout
        ' Check jQuery active connections
        ajaxActive = Browser("App").Page("Page").RunScript("return window.jQuery ? jQuery.active : 0")
        If CInt(ajaxActive) = 0 Then
            ' Also check for other frameworks
            xhrActive = Browser("App").Page("Page").RunScript(_
                "var count = 0; if (window.XMLHttpRequest) count = 1; return count;")
            If CInt(xhrActive) = 0 Then
                WaitForAjax = True
                Exit Function
            End If
        End If
        Wait 1
    Loop
    
    WaitForAjax = False
End Function

' Wait for element to appear with AJAX check
Function WaitForElementWithAjax(elementDesc, timeout)
    Dim startTime
    startTime = Timer
    
    Do While Timer < startTime + timeout
        If elementDesc.Exist(0) Then
            ' Element found, wait for AJAX to complete
            WaitForAjax(5)
            WaitForElementWithAjax = True
            Exit Function
        End If
        Wait 1
    Loop
    
    WaitForElementWithAjax = False
End Function

' Wait for partial page update
Function WaitForTextToAppear(element, expectedText, timeout)
    Dim startTime
    startTime = Timer
    
    Do While Timer < startTime + timeout
        currentText = element.GetROProperty("innertext")
        If InStr(currentText, expectedText) > 0 Then
            WaitForTextToAppear = True
            Exit Function
        End If
        Wait 1
    Loop
    
    WaitForTextToAppear = False
End Function
```

**3. Handling Single Page Applications (SPA)**

```vbscript
' Wait for route change
Function WaitForRoute(expectedRoute, timeout)
    Dim startTime
    startTime = Timer
    
    Do While Timer < startTime + timeout
        currentRoute = Browser("App").Page("Page").RunScript(_
            "return window.location.hash || window.location.pathname")
        If InStr(currentRoute, expectedRoute) > 0 Then
            WaitForRoute = True
            Exit Function
        End If
        Wait 1
    Loop
    
    WaitForRoute = False
End Function

' Wait for Angular to stabilize
Function WaitForAngular(timeout)
    Dim startTime
    startTime = Timer
    
    Do While Timer < startTime + timeout
        hasPendingTasks = Browser("App").Page("Page").RunScript(_
            "if (window.angular) {" & _
            "  var injector = angular.element(document).injector();" & _
            "  var $http = injector.get('$http');" & _
            "  return $http.pendingRequests.length === 0;" & _
            "} else { return true; }")
        
        If hasPendingTasks = "true" Then
            WaitForAngular = True
            Exit Function
        End If
        Wait 1
    Loop
    
    WaitForAngular = False
End Function

' Wait for React to render
Function WaitForReact(timeout)
    ' React-specific waiting strategy
    Dim startTime
    startTime = Timer
    
    Do While Timer < startTime + timeout
        rendered = Browser("App").Page("Page").RunScript(_
            "return document.getElementById('root') ? " & _
            "document.getElementById('root').children.length > 0 : false")
        If rendered = "true" Then
            WaitForReact = True
            Exit Function
        End If
        Wait 1
    Loop
    
    WaitForReact = False
End Function
```

**4. Element State Waits**

```vbscript
' Wait for element to be clickable
Function WaitForElementClickable(element, timeout)
    Dim startTime
    startTime = Timer
    
    Do While Timer < startTime + timeout
        If element.Exist(0) Then
            If element.GetROProperty("disabled") = "False" And _
               element.GetROProperty("visible") = "True" Then
                WaitForElementClickable = True
                Exit Function
            End If
        End If
        Wait 1
    Loop
    
    WaitForElementClickable = False
End Function

' Wait for element to have specific value
Function WaitForElementValue(element, property, expectedValue, timeout)
    Dim startTime
    startTime = Timer
    
    Do While Timer < startTime + timeout
        currentValue = element.GetROProperty(property)
        If currentValue = expectedValue Then
            WaitForElementValue = True
            Exit Function
        End If
        Wait 1
    Loop
    
    WaitForElementValue = False
End Function

' Wait for element to disappear
Function WaitForElementToDisappear(element, timeout)
    Dim startTime
    startTime = Timer
    
    Do While Timer < startTime + timeout
        If Not element.Exist(0) Then
            WaitForElementToDisappear = True
            Exit Function
        End If
        Wait 1
    Loop
    
    WaitForElementToDisappear = False
End Function
```

**5. Multi-Condition Wait**

```vbscript
' Wait for multiple conditions
Class WebPageWait
    Private conditions
    
    Private Sub Class_Initialize()
        Set conditions = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
    End Sub
    
    Sub AddCondition(name, conditionFunction)
        conditions(name) = conditionFunction
    End Sub
    
    Function WaitForAll(timeout)
        Dim startTime, metConditions
        startTime = Timer
        Set metConditions = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
        
        Do While Timer < startTime + timeout
            Dim condition
            For Each condition In conditions.Keys
                If Not metConditions.Exists(condition) Then
                    If conditions(condition)() Then
                        metConditions(condition) = True
                    End If
                End If
            Next
            
            If metConditions.Count = conditions.Count Then
                WaitForAll = True
                Exit Function
            End If
            Wait 0.5
        Loop
        
        WaitForAll = False
    End Function
    
    Function WaitForAny(timeout)
        Dim startTime
        startTime = Timer
        
        Do While Timer < startTime + timeout
            Dim condition
            For Each condition In conditions.Keys
                If conditions(condition)() Then
                    WaitForAny = condition
                    Exit Function
                End If
            Next
            Wait 0.5
        Loop
        
        WaitForAny = ""
    End Function
End Class

' Usage
Set wait = New WebPageWait
wait.AddCondition "PageLoaded", Function() Browser("App").Page("Page").Sync(0) End Function
wait.AddCondition "AjaxComplete", Function() WaitForAjax(0) End Function
wait.AddCondition "ElementVisible", Function() Browser("App").Page("Page").WebElement("welcome").Exist(0) End Function

If wait.WaitForAll(15) Then
    Reporter.ReportEvent micPass, "Wait", "All conditions met"
End If
```

**6. Smart Wait Configuration**

```vbscript
' Adaptive wait times based on performance
Class AdaptiveWebWait
    Private waitHistory
    
    Private Sub Class_Initialize()
        Set waitHistory = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
    End Sub
    
    Function GetRecommendedTimeout(context)
        If waitHistory.Exists(context) Then
            Dim times
            times = waitHistory(context)
            
            ' Calculate average + 50% buffer
            Dim sum, avg
            sum = 0
            Dim time
            For Each time In times
                sum = sum + time
            Next
            avg = sum / waitHistory(context).Count
            
            GetRecommendedTimeout = Round(avg * 1.5, 0)
        Else
            GetRecommendedTimeout = 10 ' Default
        End If
    End Function
    
    Sub RecordWait(context, actualTime)
        If Not waitHistory.Exists(context) Then
            waitHistory(context) = Array()
        End If
        
        Dim times
        times = waitHistory(context)
        ReDim Preserve times(UBound(times) + 1)
        times(UBound(times)) = actualTime
        waitHistory(context) = times
    End Sub
    
    Function WaitWithLearning(context, waitFunction)
        Dim timeout, startTime, result
        timeout = GetRecommendedTimeout(context)
        
        startTime = Timer
        result = waitFunction(timeout)
        RecordWait context, Timer - startTime
        
        WaitWithLearning = result
    End Function
End Class
```

             "var dt = new DataTransfer();" & _

**4. Handling Downloads**

```vbscript
' Configure download directory
Setting.WebPackage("DownloadFolder") = "C:\UFT\Downloads"

' Trigger download
Browser("App").Page("Page").Link("text:=Download").Click

' Wait for download to complete
Function WaitForDownload(filePattern, timeout)
    Dim startTime, fso
    Set fso = CreateObject("Scripting.FileSystemObject")
    startTime = Timer
    
    Do While Timer < startTime + timeout
        Dim file
        For Each file In fso.GetFolder("C:\UFT\Downloads").Files
            If InStr(file.Name, filePattern) > 0 Then
                ' Check if download complete (file not locked)
                On Error Resume Next
                file.OpenAsTextStream(1, 0).ReadLine
                If Err.Number = 0 Then
                    WaitForDownload = file.Path
                    Exit Function
                End If
                Err.Clear
            End If
        Next
        Wait 1
    Loop
    
    WaitForDownload = ""
End Function
```

**10. Accessibility Testing**

```vbscript
' Basic accessibility checks
Sub CheckAccessibility()
    ' Check for alt text on images
    Set images = Browser("App").Page("Page").ChildObjects("class:=Image")
    For Each img in images
        alt = img.GetROProperty("alt")
        If alt = "" Then
            Reporter.ReportEvent micWarning, "Accessibility", _
                "Image missing alt text: " & img.GetROProperty("src")
        End If
    Next
    
    ' Check for labels on inputs
    Set inputs = Browser("App").Page("Page").ChildObjects("class:=WebEdit")
    For Each input in inputs
        id = input.GetROProperty("id")
        If id <> "" Then
            labelExists = Browser("App").Page("Page").WebElement(_
                "xpath:=//label[@for='" & id & "']").Exist(0)
            If Not labelExists Then
                Reporter.ReportEvent micWarning, "Accessibility", _
                    "Input missing associated label: " & id
            End If
        End If
    Next
    
    ' Check heading hierarchy
    CheckHeadingHierarchy()
End Sub

' Check heading structure
Sub CheckHeadingHierarchy()
    Dim lastLevel
    lastLevel = 0
    
    For i = 1 to 6
        Set headings = Browser("App").Page("Page").ChildObjects(_
            "html tag:=H" & i)
        
        For Each heading in headings
            level = i
            text = heading.GetROProperty("innertext")
            
            If level > lastLevel + 1 And lastLevel > 0 Then
                Reporter.ReportEvent micWarning, "Accessibility", _
                    "Heading level skipped from H" & lastLevel & _
                    " to H" & level & ": " & text
            End If
            
            lastLevel = level
        Next
    Next
End Sub
```

**12. Performance Testing**

```vbscript
' Measure page load performance
Function MeasurePageLoadTime(url)
    Dim startTime
    startTime = Timer
    
    Browser("App").Navigate url
    Browser("App").Page("Page").Sync
    
    MeasurePageLoadTime = Timer - startTime
    
    If MeasurePageLoadTime > 3 Then
        Reporter.ReportEvent micWarning, "Performance", _
            "Slow page load: " & Round(MeasurePageLoadTime, 2) & "s"
    End If
End Function

' Measure element interaction time
Function MeasureElementAction(element, action)
    Dim startTime
    startTime = Timer
    
    action()
    
    MeasureElementAction = Timer - startTime
End Function

' Get performance metrics from browser
Function GetPerformanceMetrics()
    metrics = Browser("App").Page("Page").RunScript(_
        "var perf = window.performance.timing;" & _
        "return {" & _
        "  dns: perf.domainLookupEnd - perf.domainLookupStart," & _
        "  connect: perf.connectEnd - perf.connectStart," & _
        "  response: perf.responseEnd - perf.responseStart," & _
        "  dom: perf.domComplete - perf.domLoading," & _
        "  load: perf.loadEventEnd - perf.navigationStart" & _
        "};")
    
    GetPerformanceMetrics = metrics
End Function
```

**13. Best Practices for Web Testing**

```vbscript
' 1. Use Page Object Model
Class LoginPage
    Private driver
    
    Private Sub Class_Initialize()
        Set driver = Browser("App").Page("Login")
    End Sub
    
    Function Login(username, password)
        driver.WebEdit("name:=username").Set username
        driver.WebEdit("name:=password").SetSecure password
        driver.WebButton("value:=Login").Click
        
        Login = Browser("App").Page("Home").Exist(5)
    End Function
    
    Function GetErrorMessage()
        GetErrorMessage = driver.WebElement("class:=error").GetROProperty("innertext")
    End Function
End Class

' 2. Implement retry logic
Function RetryOnFailure(action, maxRetries)
    Dim attempt
    For attempt = 1 to maxRetries
        On Error Resume Next
        action()
        If Err.Number = 0 Then
            RetryOnFailure = True
            Exit Function
        End If
        Err.Clear
        Wait 2
    Next
    RetryOnFailure = False
End Function

' 3. Use data-driven approach
Function ExecuteDataDrivenTest(testData)
    For Each row In testData
        Browser("App").Page("Page").WebEdit("username").Set row("Username")
        Browser("App").Page("Page").WebEdit("password").Set row("Password")
        Browser("App").Page("Page").WebButton("login").Click
        
        ' Verify
        expected = row("Expected")
        actual = Browser("App").Page("Page").WebElement("status").GetROProperty("innertext")
        
        If InStr(actual, expected) > 0 Then
            Reporter.ReportEvent micPass, "Test", "Test passed for " & row("Username")
        Else
            Reporter.ReportEvent micFail, "Test", "Test failed for " & row("Username")
        End If
        
        Browser("App").Page("Page").WebButton("logout").Click
    Next
End Function

' 4. Handle dynamic content
Function GetDynamicTableData(tableId)
    Set data = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
    
    Set table = Browser("App").Page("Page").WebTable("id:=" & tableId)
    rowCount = table.RowCount
    colCount = table.ColumnCount(1)
    
    For row = 2 to rowCount ' Skip header
        Set rowData = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
        For col = 1 to colCount
            cellText = table.GetCellData(row, col)
            rowData("col" & col) = cellText
        Next
        data(row) = rowData
    Next
    
    Set GetDynamicTableData = data
End Function

' 5. Take screenshots on failure
Sub TakeScreenshotOnFailure()
    If Reporter.RunStatus = micFail Then
        timestamp = Replace(Replace(Now(), "/", "-"), ":", "-")
        filename = "C:\Screenshots\error_" & timestamp & ".png"
        Desktop.CaptureBitmap filename, True
        Reporter.ReportEvent micDone, "Screenshot", "Saved: " & filename
    End If
End Sub

' 6. Use configuration files
Function GetConfig(key, defaultValue)
    If Environment.Exists(key) Then
        GetConfig = Environment.Value(key)
    Else
        GetConfig = defaultValue
    End If
End Function

' 7. Implement proper error recovery
Sub RecoverFromError()
    ' Try to refresh page
    Browser("App").Refresh
    Wait 3
    
    ' Check if recovered
    If Browser("App").Page("Page").Exist(5) Then
        Reporter.ReportEvent micDone, "Recovery", "Page refreshed successfully"
    Else
        ' Restart browser
        Browser("App").Close
        SystemUtil.Run GetConfig("BaseURL", "http://localhost")
        Reporter.ReportEvent micWarning, "Recovery", "Browser restarted"
    End If
End Sub

' 8. Log test execution
Sub LogTestStep(stepName, details)
    Reporter.ReportEvent micDone, stepName, _
        "Time: " & Now() & ", Details: " & details
End Sub

' 9. Clean up after tests
Sub TestCleanup()
    ' Close all browsers
    Browser("title:=.*").CloseAll
    
    ' Clear cookies
    Browser("App").DeleteCookies
    
    ' Clear cache
    Setting.WebPackage("ClearCache") = True
    
    ' Export results
    DataTable.Export "C:\Results\WebTestResults.xls"
End Sub
```

**14. Web Testing Checklist**

```
Pre-Execution:
□ Browser add-ins installed and enabled
□ Object repository configured for web elements
□ Synchronization settings optimized
□ Test data prepared
□ Environment variables set

During Execution:
□ Use explicit waits for dynamic elements

□ Capture screenshots on failures
□ Log browser console for errors

Post-Execution:
□ Close all browser instances
□ Clear cookies and cache
□ Export test results
□ Analyze performance metrics
□ Document any issues found

Maintenance:
□ Update object repositories regularly
□ Review and optimize waits
□ Remove hard-coded values
□ Update for application changes
□ Version control test scripts
```

**15. Common Web Testing Challenges**

| Challenge | Solution | Example |
|-----------|----------|---------|
| **Dynamic IDs** | Use relative properties | `name:=user_.*`, regex=true |
| **AJAX content** | Wait for AJAX completion | `WaitForAjax(10)` |
| **Timing issues** | Explicit waits | `obj.WaitProperty "visible", True, 10` |
| **Frames** | Frame navigation | `Browser.Page.Frame("main").WebEdit` |
| **Pop-ups** | Handle alerts | `Browser.Dialog.Alert.Accept` |
| **File uploads** | Set file path | `WebEdit("type:=file").Set path` |
| **SSL certificates** | Accept untrusted | `Setting.WebPackage("AcceptUntrustedCertificates") = True` |
| **Cross-browser** | Parameterize browser | `Setting.WebPackage("Browser") = browser` |
| **SPA navigation** | Wait for route | `WaitForRoute(expectedRoute, 10)` |
| **Performance** | Measure timings | `MeasurePageLoadTime(url)` |
```

content.title: Mastering Object Repository Management
content.explanation:
**The Foundation of Maintainable Tests:**

**1. Descriptive Object Naming Conventions**

```vbscript
' ✅ GOOD: Descriptive and consistent
Browser("ECommerce").Page("Login").WebEdit("txtUsername")
Browser("ECommerce").Page("Login").WebEdit("txtPassword")
Browser("ECommerce").Page("Login").WebButton("btnLogin")
Browser("ECommerce").Page("Home").WebElement("lblWelcomeMessage")
Browser("ECommerce").Page("Search").WebList("lstCategories")
Browser("ECommerce").Page("Cart").WebCheckBox("chkTerms")

' ❌ BAD: Ambiguous and inconsistent
Browser("ECommerce").Page("Login").WebEdit("edit1")
Browser("ECommerce").Page("Login").WebEdit("pass")
Browser("ECommerce").Page("Login").WebButton("login")

' Naming Convention Standards:
' Prefix + Descriptive Name
' Prefixes:
' txt - Text field
' btn - Button
' lbl - Label
' lnk - Link
' chk - Checkbox
' rad - Radio button
' lst - List/Dropdown
' img - Image
' tbl - Table
' frm - Frame
' dlg - Dialog
```

**2. Object Repository Organization**

```
Repository Structure:

Shared Repositories/
├── 00_Common/
│   ├── CommonControls.tsr (buttons, links across app)
│   ├── NavigationControls.tsr (menus, headers, footers)
│   └── ErrorMessages.tsr (error dialogs, validation messages)
├── 01_Modules/
│   ├── LoginModule.tsr (login page objects)
│   ├── UserManagement.tsr (user admin objects)
│   ├── ProductCatalog.tsr (product search/browse)
│   └── OrderProcessing.tsr (cart, checkout, payment)
├── 02_Pages/
│   ├── HomePage.tsr
│   ├── SearchPage.tsr
│   └── CheckoutPage.tsr
└── 03_Technology/
    ├── WebControls.tsr
    ├── WinControls.tsr
    └── JavaControls.tsr

Local Repositories (test-specific):
└── TestData_EdgeCases.tsr
```

**3. Object Repository Best Practices**

```vbscript
' 1. Use Shared Repositories for Common Objects
' Associate repositories in order of priority:
RepositoriesCollection.RemoveAll
RepositoriesCollection.Add "C:\Repos\CommonControls.tsr"
RepositoriesCollection.Add "C:\Repos\LoginModule.tsr"
RepositoriesCollection.Add "C:\Repos\LocalRepo.tsr"

' 2. Regular Repository Maintenance
Sub MaintainRepository()
    ' Check for unused objects
    ' Update changed properties
    ' Remove duplicates
    ' Document changes
End Sub

' 3. Version Control Integration
' Store .tsr files in Git with meaningful commit messages
' Tag repository versions with application releases

' 4. Object Documentation
' Add description to each object:
' Object: txtUsername
' Description: Username input field on login page
' Last Verified: 2025-03-20
' Notes: Hidden when remember me checked
```

**4. Property Selection Guidelines**

```vbscript
' ✅ GOOD: Stable properties
Browser("App").Page("Login").WebEdit("id:=username")
Browser("App").Page("Login").WebEdit("name:=user_name")
Browser("App").Page("Login").WebButton("value:=Submit")

' ❌ BAD: Brittle properties
Browser("App").Page("Login").WebEdit("index:=2") ' Position may change
Browser("App").Page("Login").WebEdit("xpath:=//div[3]/input[2]") ' Too specific

' Property Priority:
' 1. ID (most stable)
' 2. Name
' 3. Data-testid attributes
' 4. CSS class + type combination
' 5. XPath (last resort)

' Use regular expressions for dynamic values:
Browser("App").Page("Page").WebEdit("name:=user_\d+", "regex:=true")
```

**5. Object Identification Strategy**

```vbscript
' Smart Identification Configuration
' Tools → Object Identification
' Enable Smart Identification for resilience

' Fallback Strategy:
Function FindObject(primaryLocator, backupLocator)
    On Error Resume Next
    Set obj = primaryLocator()
    If Err.Number <> 0 Then
        Err.Clear
        Set obj = backupLocator()
    End If
    Set FindObject = obj
End Function

' Usage:
Set usernameField = FindObject(
    Function() Browser("App").Page("Login").WebEdit("id:=username") End Function,
    Function() Browser("App").Page("Login").WebEdit("name:=user") End Function
)
```

**6. Repository Performance Tips**

```vbscript
' 1. Limit repository size (max 500 objects per file)
' 2. Use folders to organize (max 5 levels deep)
' 3. Compact repositories monthly
' 4. Remove unused objects quarterly
' 5. Cache frequently used repositories

RepositoriesCollection.CacheEnabled = True
RepositoriesCollection.PreloadAll() ' During test initialization
```

**7. Object Repository Checklist**

```
✅ Creation:
□ Follow naming conventions
□ Choose appropriate repository type (shared/local)
□ Add description
□ Set proper location

✅ Maintenance:
□ Regular validation
□ Remove unused objects
□ Update changed properties
□ Document changes
□ Version control

✅ Usage:
□ Associate in correct order
□ Use descriptive programming when needed
□ Handle dynamic elements
□ Document exceptions
```

content.title: Building Reusable Test Components
content.explanation:
**The DRY (Don't Repeat Yourself) Principle:**

**1. Function Library Organization**

```
Function Libraries/
├── Core/
│   ├── BrowserUtils.vbs (browser operations)
│   ├── WaitUtils.vbs (synchronization functions)
│   ├── DataUtils.vbs (data handling)
│   └── ReportingUtils.vbs (custom reporting)
├── Business/
│   ├── LoginFunctions.vbs
│   ├── SearchFunctions.vbs
│   ├── CheckoutFunctions.vbs
│   └── PaymentFunctions.vbs
├── Application/
│   ├── Module1.vbs
│   └── Module2.vbs
└── Config/
    ├── EnvironmentConfig.vbs
    └── TestDataConfig.vbs
```

**2. Reusable Function Examples**

```vbscript
' ===========================================
' File: LoginFunctions.vbs
' Description: Reusable login functions
' Version: 2.1
' Last Updated: 2025-03-20
' ===========================================

' Core login function
Function Login(username, password, Optional rememberMe = False)
    On Error Resume Next
    
    Reporter.ReportEvent micDone, "Login", _
        "Attempting login with user: " & username
    
    ' Wait for login page
    If Not WaitForLoginPage(10) Then
        Reporter.ReportEvent micFail, "Login", "Login page not loaded"
        Login = False
        Exit Function
    End If
    
    ' Enter credentials
    With Browser("App").Page("Login")
        .WebEdit("txtUsername").Set username
        .WebEdit("txtPassword").SetSecure EncryptPassword(password)
        
        If rememberMe Then
            .WebCheckBox("chkRemember").Set "ON"
        End If
        
        .WebButton("btnLogin").Click
    End With
    
    ' Wait for response
    Login = WaitForLoginResult(10)
    
    If Err.Number <> 0 Then
        Reporter.ReportEvent micFail, "Login", "Error: " & Err.Description
        Login = False
    End If
End Function

' Helper: Wait for login page
Function WaitForLoginPage(timeout)
    WaitForLoginPage = Browser("App").Page("Login").Sync(timeout)
End Function

' Helper: Wait for login result
Function WaitForLoginResult(timeout)
    Dim startTime
    startTime = Timer
    
    Do While Timer < startTime + timeout
        If Browser("App").Page("Home").Exist(0) Then
            WaitForLoginResult = True
            Exit Function
        End If
        If Browser("App").Page("Login").WebElement("lblError").Exist(0) Then
            WaitForLoginResult = False
            Exit Function
        End If
        Wait 1
    Loop
    
    WaitForLoginResult = False
End Function

' Helper: Get login error message
Function GetLoginError()
    If Browser("App").Page("Login").WebElement("lblError").Exist(3) Then
        GetLoginError = Browser("App").Page("Login").WebElement("lblError").GetROProperty("innertext")
    Else
        GetLoginError = ""
    End If
End Function
```

**3. Action Decomposition**

```vbscript
' Instead of one large action:
Action1 (200 lines) - BAD

' Break into smaller actions:
├── Action1_NavigateToPage (20 lines)
├── Action2_EnterData (30 lines)
├── Action3_SubmitForm (15 lines)
├── Action4_VerifyResults (25 lines)
└── Action5_Cleanup (10 lines)

' Calling sequence:
RunAction "NavigateToPage", oneIteration
RunAction "EnterData", oneIteration
RunAction "SubmitForm", oneIteration
RunAction "VerifyResults", oneIteration
RunAction "Cleanup", oneIteration
```

**4. Parameter Passing**

```vbscript
' Action with input parameters
' Action: Login
' Input Parameters:
'   - username (string)
'   - password (string)
'   - rememberMe (boolean)
' Output Parameters:
'   - loginStatus (boolean)
'   - errorMessage (string)

' Calling action with parameters
RunAction "Login", oneIteration, _
    Parameter("username", "admin"), _
    Parameter("password", "pass123"), _
    Parameter("rememberMe", True)

' Retrieving output
loginStatus = Parameter("loginStatus")
errorMessage = Parameter("errorMessage")
```

**5. Component-Based Design**

```vbscript
' Create reusable components
Class NavigationBar
    Private driver
    
    Private Sub Class_Initialize()
        Set driver = Browser("App").Page("Home")
    End Sub
    
    Function GoToProfile()
        driver.Link("lnkUserMenu").Click

    Function GoToCart()

    Function Logout()

        driver.Link("lnkLogout").Click
    End Function
End Class

' Usage
Set nav = New NavigationBar
nav.GoToProfile()
```

**6. Framework Layers**

```
Test Framework Architecture:

Layer 1: Test Scripts (Tests)
├── LoginTests
├── SearchTests
└── CheckoutTests

Layer 2: Business Functions (Page Objects)
├── LoginPage
├── SearchPage
└── CheckoutPage

Layer 3: Core Functions (Utilities)
├── BrowserUtils
├── DataUtils
├── WaitUtils
└── ReportingUtils

Layer 4: Configuration
├── Environment Settings
├── Test Data
└── Object Repositories
```

**7. Code Reusability Metrics**

| Metric | Target | Measurement |
|--------|--------|-------------|
| **Code duplication** | < 5% | Count duplicate lines |
| **Function reuse** | > 80% | Functions called multiple times |
| **Action modularity** | < 50 lines/action | Average action size |
| **Library coverage** | > 90% | Tests using libraries |
| **Parameterization** | 100% | No hard-coded values |

**8. Modularization Checklist**

```
✅ Design Phase:
□ Identify reusable components
□ Plan function library structure
□ Define standard interfaces
□ Document module dependencies

✅ Implementation:
□ Create single-purpose functions
□ Use meaningful function names
□ Add parameter validation
□ Include error handling
□ Document usage examples

✅ Maintenance:
□ Track function usage
□ Update dependent modules
□ Version control libraries
□ Deprecate obsolete functions
```

content.title: Robust Synchronization Strategies
content.explanation:
**Never Use Thread.Sleep:**

**1. Wait Strategy Guidelines**

```vbscript
' ❌ NEVER DO THIS:
Wait 5 ' Always waits 5 seconds - BAD

' ✅ DO THIS:
If Browser("App").Page("Login").WebEdit("username").WaitProperty("visible", True, 5) Then
    ' Proceed
Else
    ' Handle timeout
End If

' Wait Decision Guide:
' Page Load → Browser.Sync or Page.Sync
' Element Existence → obj.Exist(timeout)
' Element Visible → obj.WaitProperty "visible", True, timeout
' Element Enabled → obj.WaitProperty "disabled", False, timeout
' Property Change → obj.WaitProperty property, expected, timeout
' AJAX Complete → Custom WaitForAjax function
```

**2. Smart Wait Configuration**

```vbscript
' Centralized wait configuration
Class WaitConfiguration
    Private config
    
    Private Sub Class_Initialize()
        Set config = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
        config("pageLoad") = 20
        config("elementExists") = 10
        config("elementVisible") = 8
        config("ajaxComplete") = 15
        config("propertyChange") = 10
    End Sub
    
    Function GetTimeout(context)
        If config.Exists(context) Then
            GetTimeout = config(context)
        Else
            GetTimeout = 10 ' Default
        End If
    End Function
    
    Sub SetTimeout(context, seconds)
        config(context) = seconds
    End Sub
End Class

Set waitConfig = New WaitConfiguration
pageTimeout = waitConfig.GetTimeout("pageLoad")
```

**3. Custom Wait Functions**

```vbscript
' Generic wait function
Function WaitFor(conditionFunction, timeout, checkInterval)
    Dim startTime
    startTime = Timer
    
    Do While Timer < startTime + timeout
        If conditionFunction() Then
            WaitFor = True
            Exit Function
        End If
        Wait checkInterval
    Loop
    
    WaitFor = False
End Function

' Usage:
If WaitFor(Function() Browser("App").Page("Home").Exist(0) End Function, 15, 1) Then
    ' Page loaded
End If

' Multi-condition wait
Function WaitForAll(conditions, timeout)
    Dim startTime, met
    startTime = Timer
    met = 0
    
    Do While Timer < startTime + timeout
        met = 0
        For Each cond In conditions
            If cond() Then met = met + 1
        Next
        If met = UBound(conditions) + 1 Then
            WaitForAll = True
            Exit Function
        End If
        Wait 0.5
    Loop
    
    WaitForAll = False
End Function
```

**4. Synchronization Patterns**

```vbscript
' Pattern 1: Progressive Timeout
Function GetProgressiveTimeout(baseTimeout, attempt)
    GetProgressiveTimeout = baseTimeout * (1 + (attempt * 0.5))
End Function

' Pattern 2: Adaptive Wait
Class AdaptiveWait
    Private history
    
    Private Sub Class_Initialize()
        Set history = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
    End Sub
    
    Function Wait(context, condition, baseTimeout)
        Dim timeout
        If history.Exists(context) Then
            timeout = baseTimeout * (1 + history(context)("failureRate"))
        Else
            timeout = baseTimeout
        End If
        
        Dim startTime
        startTime = Timer
        result = condition()
        
        If Not result Then
            If Not history.Exists(context) Then
                Set history(context) = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
                history(context)("failures") = 0
                history(context)("total") = 0
            End If
            history(context)("failures") = history(context)("failures") + 1
            history(context)("total") = history(context)("total") + 1
            history(context)("failureRate") = history(context)("failures") / history(context)("total")
        End If
        
        Wait = result
    End Function
End Class

' Pattern 3: Retry with Backoff
Function RetryWithBackoff(action, maxRetries)
    Dim delay
    delay = 1
    
    For attempt = 1 to maxRetries
        On Error Resume Next
        action()
        If Err.Number = 0 Then
            RetryWithBackoff = True
            Exit Function
        End If
        Err.Clear
        Wait delay
        delay = delay * 2 ' Exponential backoff
    Next
    
    RetryWithBackoff = False
End Function
```

**5. Synchronization Checklist**

```
✅ Pre-Execution:
□ Set appropriate global timeouts
□ Configure environment-specific waits
□ Load wait configuration

✅ During Test:
□ Use explicit waits for critical elements
□ Check return values of wait methods
□ Log wait times for performance tracking
□ Handle timeout exceptions gracefully

✅ Post-Execution:
□ Analyze wait performance metrics
□ Identify slow operations
□ Adjust wait times based on trends
□ Document any timing issues
```

**6. Common Synchronization Anti-Patterns**

| Anti-Pattern | Problem | Solution |
|--------------|---------|----------|
| **Thread.Sleep** | Always waits full time | Use conditional waits |
| **No timeout** | Infinite loops | Always add timeout |
| **Too short** | Flaky tests | Increase appropriately |
| **Too long** | Slow tests | Optimize, use adaptive waits |
| **Wrong condition** | False passes | Wait for correct state |
| **No error handling** | Silent failures | Handle timeout cases |

**7. Performance Impact**

```vbscript
' Measure wait efficiency
Function AnalyzeWaitPerformance(waitFunction, iterations)
    Dim totalTime, successes
    totalTime = 0
    successes = 0
    
    For i = 1 to iterations
        Dim startTime
        startTime = Timer
        result = waitFunction()
        totalTime = totalTime + (Timer - startTime)
        If result Then successes = successes + 1
    Next
    
    Reporter.ReportEvent micDone, "Wait Analysis", _
        "Avg time: " & Round(totalTime/iterations, 2) & "s, " & _
        "Success rate: " & Round((successes/iterations)*100, 2) & "%"
End Function
```

**8. Best Practices Summary**

```vbscript
' 1. Never use static waits
' ❌ Wait 5
' ✅ obj.WaitProperty "visible", True, 5

' 2. Always check return values
If Not Browser("App").Page("Home").Sync(10) Then
    HandleTimeout()
End If

' 3. Use appropriate timeout values
Const PAGE_LOAD_TIMEOUT = 30
Const ELEMENT_TIMEOUT = 10
Const AJAX_TIMEOUT = 15

' 4. Implement timeout in all loops
startTime = Timer
Do While Not condition()
    If Timer - startTime > timeout Then Exit Do
    Wait 1
Loop

' 5. Log wait times for optimization
waitTime = Timer - startTime
If waitTime > threshold Then
    Reporter.ReportEvent micWarning, "Performance", _
        "Slow operation: " & Round(waitTime, 2) & "s"
End If
```

content.title: Robust Error Management
content.explanation:
**Building Resilient Tests:**

**1. Error Handling Hierarchy**

```vbscript
' Level 1: Inline error handling
On Error Resume Next
' Risky operation
If Err.Number <> 0 Then
    HandleError Err.Description
    Err.Clear
End If

' Level 2: Function-level handling
Function SafeOperation()
    On Error Resume Next
    ' Operations
    If Err.Number <> 0 Then
        SafeOperation = False
        LogError Err.Description
        Err.Clear
    Else
        SafeOperation = True
    End If
End Function

' Level 3: Test-level recovery
Sub TestWithRecovery()
    On Error Resume Next
    ' Test steps
    If Err.Number <> 0 Then
        ExecuteRecovery()
        If Not Recovered Then
            Reporter.ReportEvent micFail, "Test", "Failed after recovery"
            Exit Sub
        End If
    End If
End Sub

' Level 4: Framework-level recovery
' Use UFT Recovery Scenario Manager
' Configure for:
' - Application crashes
' - Pop-up windows
' - Object not found
' - Timeout errors
```

**2. Recovery Scenario Configuration**

```vbscript
' Recovery Scenario Example
' Trigger: Object not found
' Recovery Step: Refresh page
' Post-Recovery: Retry step

' Programmatic recovery
Function HandleObjectNotFound(objPath)
    Reporter.ReportEvent micWarning, "Recovery", _
        "Object not found: " & objPath
    
    ' Try refresh
    Browser("App").Refresh
    Wait 3
    
    ' Check if recovered
    On Error Resume Next
    Set obj = Eval(objPath)
    If Err.Number = 0 Then
        HandleObjectNotFound = True
        Reporter.ReportEvent micPass, "Recovery", "Object found after refresh"
    Else
        HandleObjectNotFound = False
        Reporter.ReportEvent micFail, "Recovery", "Recovery failed"
    End If
End Function
```

**3. Custom Error Logger**

```vbscript
Class ErrorLogger
    Private logFile
    Private errors
    
    Sub Class_Initialize()
        Set errors = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
        logFile = "C:\Logs\UFT_Errors_" & GetTimestamp() & ".log"
    End Sub
    
    Sub LogError(context, message, screenshot)
        Dim errorId
        errorId = errors.Count + 1
        
        Set errorInfo = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
        errorInfo("timestamp") = Now()
        errorInfo("context") = context
        errorInfo("message") = message
        errorInfo("screenshot") = screenshot
        
        errors(errorId) = errorInfo
        
        ' Write to log file
        WriteToLog errorInfo
        
        ' Report in UFT
        Reporter.ReportEvent micFail, context, _
            message & " (Error ID: " & errorId & ")"
    End Sub
    
    Sub WriteToLog(errorInfo)
        Dim fso, file
        Set fso = CreateObject("Scripting.FileSystemObject")
        Set file = fso.OpenTextFile(logFile, 8, True) ' Append
        
        file.WriteLine "[" & errorInfo("timestamp") & "] " & _
                      errorInfo("context") & ": " & _
                      errorInfo("message") & _
                      IIf(errorInfo("screenshot") <> "", " - Screenshot: " & errorInfo("screenshot"), "")
        file.Close
    End Sub
    
    Function GetErrorSummary()
        Dim summary
        summary = "Error Summary: " & errors.Count & " errors" & vbNewLine
        
        Dim i
        For i = 1 to errors.Count
            summary = summary & i & ": [" & errors(i)("context") & "] " & _
                     errors(i)("message") & vbNewLine
        Next
        
        GetErrorSummary = summary
    End Function
    
    Function GetTimestamp()
        GetTimestamp = Year(Now) & Month(Now) & Day(Now) & "_" & _
                       Hour(Now) & Minute(Now) & Second(Now)
    End Function
    
    Private Function IIf(condition, trueValue, falseValue)
        If condition Then IIf = trueValue Else IIf = falseValue
    End Function
End Class
```

**4. Retry Mechanisms**

```vbscript
' Retry with configurable parameters
Function Retry(operation, maxRetries, delayBetweenRetries)
    Dim attempt
    For attempt = 1 to maxRetries
        On Error Resume Next
        operation()
        If Err.Number = 0 Then
            Retry = True
            Exit Function
        End If
        Err.Clear
        If attempt < maxRetries Then
            Reporter.ReportEvent micWarning, "Retry", _
                "Attempt " & attempt & " failed, retrying in " & delayBetweenRetries & "s"
            Wait delayBetweenRetries
        End If
    Next
    
    Retry = False
    Reporter.ReportEvent micFail, "Retry", _
        "All " & maxRetries & " attempts failed"
End Function

' Usage
If Not Retry(Function() Login("user", "pass") End Function, 3, 2) Then
    ' Handle complete failure
End If

' Retry with exponential backoff
Function RetryExponential(operation, maxRetries)
    Dim attempt, delay
    delay = 1
    
    For attempt = 1 to maxRetries
        On Error Resume Next
        operation()
        If Err.Number = 0 Then
            RetryExponential = True
            Exit Function
        End If
        Err.Clear
        
        Reporter.ReportEvent micWarning, "Retry", _
            "Attempt " & attempt & " failed, waiting " & delay & "s"
        Wait delay
        delay = delay * 2 ' Exponential backoff
    Next
    
    RetryExponential = False
End Function
```

**5. Graceful Degradation**

```vbscript
' Test can continue with limited functionality
Function ExecuteWithFallback(primary, fallback)
    On Error Resume Next
    primary()
    If Err.Number <> 0 Then
        Err.Clear
        Reporter.ReportEvent micWarning, "Fallback", _
            "Using fallback method"
        fallback()
        If Err.Number <> 0 Then
            ExecuteWithFallback = False
        Else
            ExecuteWithFallback = True
        End If
    Else
        ExecuteWithFallback = True
    End If
End Function

' Example
ExecuteWithFallback _
    Function() Browser("App").Page("Page").WebButton("btnSubmit").Click End Function, _
    Function() Browser("App").Page("Page").WebButton("btnSave").Click End Function
```

**6. Test Continuation on Failure**

```vbscript
' Soft assertions - continue test after failure
Class SoftAssert
    Private failures
    
    Private Sub Class_Initialize()
        Set failures = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
    End Sub
    
    Sub AssertTrue(condition, message)
        If Not condition Then
            Dim id
            id = failures.Count + 1
            failures(id) = message
            Reporter.ReportEvent micWarning, "Soft Assert", message
        End If
    End Sub
    
    Function VerifyAll()
        If failures.Count > 0 Then
            Dim summary
            summary = "Soft assertions failed: " & failures.Count & vbNewLine
            Dim i
            For i = 1 to failures.Count
                summary = summary & i & ". " & failures(i) & vbNewLine
            Next
            Reporter.ReportEvent micFail, "Soft Assert Summary", summary
            VerifyAll = False
        Else
            Reporter.ReportEvent micPass, "Soft Assert Summary", "All assertions passed"
            VerifyAll = True
        End If
    End Function
End Class

' Usage
Set soft = New SoftAssert
soft.AssertTrue page.Loaded, "Page should load"
soft.AssertTrue element.Exist(0), "Element should exist"
' Continue test...
If Not soft.VerifyAll() Then
    ' Handle failures at end
End If
```

**7. Error Handling Checklist**

```
✅ Prevention:
□ Validate inputs before use
□ Check object existence before interaction
□ Use appropriate waits
□ Handle expected exceptions

✅ Detection:
□ Monitor error conditions
□ Log all errors with context
□ Take screenshots on failure
□ Capture system state

✅ Recovery:
□ Define recovery scenarios
□ Implement retry logic
□ Have fallback options
□ Clean up after recovery

✅ Reporting:
□ Log error details
□ Attach evidence (screenshots)
□ Categorize errors
□ Track error trends
```

**8. Common Error Patterns**

| Error Pattern | Cause | Solution |
|---------------|-------|----------|
| **Object not found** | Element missing/changed | Update repository, add wait |
| **Timeout** | Slow application | Increase timeout, optimize |
| **Stale element** | Page refreshed | Re-find element |
| **Popup/alert** | Unexpected dialog | Handle in recovery |
| **Application crash** | System error | Restart application |
| **Data error** | Invalid test data | Validate data, use defaults |

**9. Error Handling Best Practices**

```vbscript
' 1. Be specific with error handling
On Error Resume Next
' Only wrap risky operations

' 2. Always clear error after handling
If Err.Number <> 0 Then
    HandleError()
    Err.Clear
End If

' 3. Provide context in error messages
Reporter.ReportEvent micFail, "Login", _
    "Failed to enter username: " & username & " - " & Err.Description

' 4. Include recovery information
If Not Recovered Then
    Reporter.ReportEvent micFail, "Recovery", _
        "All recovery attempts failed. Test cannot continue."
    ExitTest
End If

' 5. Log for analysis
LogError context, message, screenshotPath

' 6. Clean up after errors
Sub ErrorCleanup()
    On Error Resume Next
    Browser("App").Close
    DataTable.Export "C:\Results\PartialResults.xls"
    Set excel = Nothing
End Sub

**4. Test Data Generation**

```vbscript
' Generate unique test data
Class TestDataGenerator
    
    Private Sub Class_Initialize()
        Randomize
    End Sub
    
    Function UniqueString(prefix)
        UniqueString = prefix & "_" & GetTimestamp()
    End Function
    
    Function UniqueEmail()
        UniqueEmail = "testuser_" & GetTimestamp() & "@test.com"
    End Function
    
    Function GetTimestamp()
        GetTimestamp = Year(Now) & Month(Now) & Day(Now) & "_" & _
                       Hour(Now) & Minute(Now) & Second(Now)
    End Function
    
    Function RandomString(length)
        Dim chars, result, i
        chars = "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789"
        result = ""
        For i = 1 to length
            result = result & Mid(chars, Int(Rnd * Len(chars)) + 1, 1)
        Next
        RandomString = result
    End Function
    
    Function RandomNumber(min, max)
        RandomNumber = Int((max - min + 1) * Rnd + min)
    End Function
End Class
```

**5. Data Validation**

```vbscript
' Validate test data before use
Function ValidateTestData()
    Dim errors
    errors = 0
    
    ' Check required columns
    required = Array("Username", "Password")
    For Each col In required
        On Error Resume Next
        value = DataTable.Value(col, dtGlobalSheet)
        If Err.Number <> 0 Then
            errors = errors + 1
            Reporter.ReportEvent micFail, "Data Validation", _
                "Required column missing: " & col
        End If
    Next
    
    ' Validate data values
    rowCount = DataTable.GetSheet("Global").GetRowCount
    For row = 1 to rowCount
        DataTable.SetCurrentRow row
        
        username = DataTable.Value("Username", dtGlobalSheet)
        password = DataTable.Value("Password", dtGlobalSheet)
        
        If username = "" Then
            errors = errors + 1
            Reporter.ReportEvent micWarning, "Data Validation", _
                "Row " & row & ": Username is empty"
        End If
        
        If Len(password) < 6 Then
            errors = errors + 1
            Reporter.ReportEvent micWarning, "Data Validation", _
                "Row " & row & ": Password too short"
        End If
        
        DataTable.SetNextRow
    Next
    
    ValidateTestData = (errors = 0)
End Function
```

**8. Data Security**

```vbscript
' Handle sensitive data securely
Class SecureDataHandler
    Private encryptionKey
    
    Private Sub Class_Initialize()
        encryptionKey = Environment.Value("EncryptionKey")
    End Sub
    
    Function MaskData(value, visibleChars)
        If Len(value) <= visibleChars Then
            MaskData = String(Len(value), "*")
        Else
            Dim visible, masked
            visible = Right(value, visibleChars)
            masked = String(Len(value) - visibleChars, "*")
            MaskData = masked & visible
        End If
    End Function
    
    Function Encrypt(value)
        ' Use proper encryption in production
        Dim result, i, charCode, keyCode
        result = ""
        For i = 1 to Len(value)
            charCode = Asc(Mid(value, i, 1))
            keyCode = Asc(Mid(encryptionKey, ((i-1) Mod Len(encryptionKey)) + 1, 1))
            result = result & Chr(charCode Xor keyCode)
        Next
        Encrypt = result
    End Function
    
    Function Decrypt(value)
        Decrypt = Encrypt(value) ' XOR is symmetric
    End Function
End Class
```

**Faster Tests, Faster Feedback:**

**1. Object Lookup Optimization**

```vbscript
' ❌ SLOW: Repeated object lookups
For i = 1 to 100
    Browser("App").Page("Search").WebEdit("q").Set "item" & i
Next

' ✅ FAST: Cache object reference
Set searchBox = Browser("App").Page("Search").WebEdit("q")
For i = 1 to 100
    searchBox.Set "item" & i
Next

' Use With statement
With Browser("App").Page("Login")
    .WebEdit("username").Set username
    .WebEdit("password").Set password
    .WebButton("login").Click
End With
```

**2. Wait Optimization**

```vbscript
' ❌ BAD: Fixed waits
Wait 5 ' Always waits

' ✅ GOOD: Conditional waits
If Not Browser("App").Page("Page").Sync(5) Then
    HandleTimeout()
End If

' Use shortest effective timeout
' Instead of:
Browser("App").Page("Page").Sync(30)

' Use:
If Not Browser("App").Page("Page").Sync(10) Then
    RefreshPage()
    Browser("App").Page("Page").Sync(10)
End If
```

**3. Data Table Optimization**

```vbscript
' Cache row count
rowCount = DataTable.GetSheet("Global").GetRowCount ' Get once
For i = 1 to rowCount ' Fast
    DataTable.SetCurrentRow i
    ' Process
Next

' Batch updates
' Instead of updating each row:
For i = 1 to rowCount
    DataTable.SetCurrentRow i
    DataTable.Value("Status", dtGlobalSheet) = status
    DataTable.SetNextRow
Next

' Collect results and update at end:
For i = 1 to rowCount
    DataTable.SetCurrentRow i
    statusArray(i) = testStatus
Next
' After loop, update all
```

**4. Disable Unnecessary Features**

```vbscript
' In test settings:
' - Disable Active Screen capture

Reporter.Filters = rfDisableAll
Reporter.ReportPath = "" ' Disable reporting during run
```

**6. Performance Profiling**

```vbscript
Class PerformanceProfiler
    Private metrics
    
    Private Sub Class_Initialize()
        Set metrics = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
    End Sub
    
    Sub StartTimer(operation)
        metrics(operation) = Timer
    End Sub
    
    Sub StopTimer(operation)
        Dim duration
        duration = Timer - metrics(operation)
        
        If duration > 5 Then
            Reporter.ReportEvent micWarning, "Performance", _
                operation & " took " & Round(duration, 2) & " seconds"
        End If
        
        ' Store for trending
        StoreMetric operation, duration
    End Sub
    
    Sub StoreMetric(operation, duration)
        ' Store in file or database for trend analysis
    End Sub
    
    Function GetReport()
        Dim report
        report = "Performance Report" & vbNewLine
        ' Generate report
        GetReport = report
    End Function
End Class
```

**7. Resource Management**

```vbscript
' Close unused applications
Sub CleanupResources()
    On Error Resume Next
    
    ' Close browsers
    Browser("title:=.*").CloseAll
    
    ' Release COM objects
    Set excel = Nothing
    Set fso = Nothing
    Set xml = Nothing
    
    ' Clear cache
    Setting.WebPackage("ClearCache") = True
    
    ' Delete temporary files
    Dim fso
    Set fso = CreateObject("Scripting.FileSystemObject")
    If fso.FolderExists("C:\Temp\UFT") Then
        fso.DeleteFolder "C:\Temp\UFT", True
    End If
End Sub
```

**10. Continuous Improvement**

```vbscript
' Track and improve over time
Sub AnalyzePerformanceTrends()
    ' Load historical data
    Set history = LoadPerformanceHistory()
    
    ' Identify slowest tests
    slowTests = GetSlowTests(history, 10) ' Top 10
    
    ' Flag for optimization
    For Each test In slowTests
        Reporter.ReportEvent micWarning, "Performance", _
            test.Name & " is consistently slow (avg: " & test.AvgTime & "s)"
    Next
    
    ' Track improvements
    For Each test In optimizedTests
        improvement = CalculateImprovement(test)
        If improvement > 20 Then
            Reporter.ReportEvent micPass, "Performance", _
                test.Name & " improved by " & improvement & "%"
        End If
    Next
End Sub
```
